guide.title: Bounded multivariate parameter regions
guide.summary: for group functions affine in a parameter vector (d = 1..4) over a declared box or polytope, the exact regions where each group attains the minimum or maximum: convex polytopes with exact vertices, irredundant integer inequalities, LP evidence of nonemptiness, ties on facets and vertices under a declared tie policy, and exact point location of many values on the CPU or CUDA; quadratics only under an explicit piecewise-linear contract, labelled approximate with a certified error.

ENV-002.cpu: Native C (math_region.c; the lookup functions inline in math_region.h): for groups whose functions are affine in a parameter vector of dimension d = 1..4 with exact rational coefficients (FND-009 big rationals), over a declared box with up to 64 further linear rows (P nonempty with an interior, decided by an exact OPT-002 LP), identical functions merged into classes; a kd-tree candidate index on a dyadic lattice with exact corner bounds and pairwise-difference pruning; per candidate class the region R_c = {theta in P : f_c <= f_c' for every c'} computed exactly from its index neighbours (Q_c = R_c whenever R_c is nonempty) by the double description method in homogeneous integer coordinates with the combinatorial adjacency test: nonempty regions of full or lower dimension with exact vertices, irredundant primitive integer inequalities and implicit equalities (exact ranks), the sources of every facet (box faces, rows, the classes tied along it), and each region's exact LP evidence (OPT-002 simplex: the maximum margin and its point) checked against the enumeration; vertices deduplicated with their tied classes and walls; boundaries (wall, cell, inner) with the classes tied on them; a declared tie policy (smallest or largest member group) names the winner; the maximizer by negation. Point location of many values (int64 arrays or big rationals) by the kd-tree, by every region's description or by every class, all exact through residues modulo INV-001's verified primes with Garner signs and a proven bound. Quadratic coefficients are refused unless the explicit piecewise-linear contract is declared: per cell an affine function with an exact remainder enclosure |q - L| <= eps, the largest eps checked against the declared error budget, the result labelled approximate (an exact use refused through FND-007). Budgets are checked before allocation or counted exactly and refused at limit + 1; nothing is truncated.
ENV-002.gpu: math_region_gpu.cu: tr_mgpu_region_locate copies a lookup job's view (the classes' residues, the kd-tree, the regions' inequalities, the cells) to the device and answers one parameter value per work item with the same inline tr_region_answer_one as the CPU (index, regions or all modes: status, kind, cell, tied classes, winner, class, region), each into its own output slots, so the answers do not depend on the order of the threads and equal the CPU bit for bit (emulated with a scrambled thread order in the tests); the output and device-byte budgets are checked on the host before launching. The region build is CPU only.
budgets: Build, before allocation: variables = d, degree (1, or 2 under the contract), states = cells x groups, bytes = the function tables.

Build, counted exactly and refused at limit + 1 with that need (nothing partial, never truncated): output = nonempty regions, support = region-vertex incidences, circuit = index nodes, iterations = index nodes + clipping steps + LP pivots, bytes = the tables as they grow.
Lookups: output = values, bytes = the job (CUDA: plus every device copy, checked together before launching).
limitations: Affine functions in d <= 4 only; curved (quadratic) regions exist only as the labelled piecewise-linear approximation with a certified error, never as exact regions.

The build is single-threaded CPU code whose work grows with the regions, their vertices and their index neighbours (measured: 1,024 tangent planes in d = 2 about 11 s, 64 in d = 4 about 6 s on the 2-core development machine); the CUDA path is point location only.
At most 64 rows besides the box, a certifying LP of at most 255 rows, lookup values within 64 moduli (about 3,900 bits).
No FND-007 certificate kind describes a region: the LP evidence and the vertex enumeration are cross-checked natively, and FND-007 is used to refuse the exact use of an approximate result.
